text.p: These are the leading stories in the Skopje press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Macedonian court administration is on strike from Tuesday. Their trade union demands salary increase and improvement of working conditions.
- Macedonia and China signed agreements on joint investments, avoidance of double taxation, cooperation of chambers of commerce and cultural cooperation.
- National Bank of Macedonia has become a member of the Basle-based Bank for International Settlements (BIS).

- Macedonian Foreign Minister Blagoj Handziski met Bulgarian and Greek foreign ministers and the Russian deputy foreign minister during the ministerial conference in Thessaloniki. Greece is interested in investing in Macedonia.

- Leader of Liberal Democratic Party Petar Gosev welcomed Macedonia's participation in the Thessaloniki ministerial conference. "This represents development of relations between neighbouring countries and a way for European integration of Balkan countries."
- Macedonian government to discuss on Tuesday the new law on the use of flags of national minorities in Macedonia.
- Ethnic Albanian PDPA and PDP said Albanians will not accept any changes to their national flag. -- Mircela Casule, Skopje newsroom +389 91 201 196
